senses.definition: Composed of the shells of dead marine creatures

quotes.text: After all, we live today in an unusual world: sea level is low, the continents are dispersed, ice occupies the poles, and the shelly fauna of the oceans is composed largely of aragonite rather than calcite.

senses.definition: Resembling, or comprising, the shell of a mollusc

quotes.text: Shrined are your offspring in a chrystal cradle, / Brighter than Helen's ere she yet had burst / Her shelly prison.
quotes.reference: 1818, Charles Lamb, “On the Sight of Swans in Kensington Garden”, in The Works of Charles and Mary Lamb:

quotes.text: It is seen commonly in connection with flat-foot, and where the horn of the wall is thin and shelly.
